tasks.goal: Problem-solver results (resolved/escalated/unknown) should be consumed by the planner in the owner workflow, not leak out as top-level escalation events. The planner should reconcile them into the task tree — retry, accept, block, or supersede the affected task branch.

context.problem: 19 of 33 pending escalations were actually successful work results from the problem-solver. They reported as escalation.created because project.problem.unknown/escalated events bypass the planner and leak to the escalation handler.
context.escalation_chain: worker → problem-solver → planner → may → human. Each level handles what it can. Currently the planner doesn't consume problem results, so they skip straight to may/human escalation.
context.fix_direction: The app's event routing (app.ts onEvent or a workflowHandler) should handle project.problem.resolved/escalated/unknown by waking the planner with the result context. The planner reconciles: retry affected tasks (resolved), mark blocker (escalated), or investigate (unknown). Only if the planner can't resolve should it escalate further.
